title: Bouly&Cailloux accessories: boutique selection, bags and small objects
author: Les Caramagnols
excerpt: The Bouly&Cailloux accessory family extends the jewelry range with a simple selection of bags, keyrings, cufflinks and chosen objects that keep the workshop spirit intact.
content:
At Bouly&Cailloux, the accessory family does not replace jewelry. It comes alongside it, with pieces that extend the universe of the brand without shifting it elsewhere. The accessory category gathers bags, keyrings, cufflinks and a few chosen objects looked at with the same eye as the workshop creations.

A discreet extension of the shop

This family has a clear role. It broadens the offer without turning Bouly&Cailloux into a mixed display of unrelated objects. The line remains with simple, useful forms that can enter daily life easily.

That matters because the workshop already rests on a readable direction: wearable materials, attention to handwork and a direct relation to use. The accessories keep that logic rather than contradicting it.

Bags keyrings and cufflinks

Within this category, bags hold an obvious place, especially when they are crocheted by hand. Keyrings stay in a smaller and more practical register, sometimes more spontaneous. Cufflinks open another use entirely, more occasional but still restrained.

Handmade pieces and chosen selection

Not everything carries exactly the same status in this family. Some pieces belong directly to the handmade line, while others sit more clearly in the boutique selection. What keeps the whole together is not an identical origin for every object, but the consistency of the choice. The accessories remain because they extend the workshop taste for simple, useful and durable objects.

That is also what prevents a disconnected catalog effect. The bag, the keyring or the cufflink do not imitate jewelry. They occupy another place while staying inside the same restrained use.

Why this family works with the rest

An artisan shop can benefit from showing something beyond its main family, provided it does not lose direction. Here the accessories work precisely because they do not erase the jewelry or take its place. They accompany it. The whole category remains visible on the official Bouly&Cailloux accessory page.

To return to the wider frame, the Bouly&Cailloux page presents the workshop in Cogolin and its local anchor. And to come back to the easiest everyday part of the B&C universe, the article on Bouly&Cailloux bracelets offers a good entry point.
